result.brief: 提出简化的在线策略速度回归蒸馏框架 SMD，用训练期残差代理 Pivot 与弱教师排斥机制实现 4-NFE 少步生成，并验证于视频与音视频联合生成。
result.reason: Few-step distillation for diffusion/flow models, evaluated on video synthesis and joint audio-video generation; regression-based on-policy velocity distillation transfers to video generation efficiency.
